environment.description: NestJS microservice deployed on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB) with an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL. The WebACL includes the AWS managed rule group AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with CrossSiteScripting_BODY, CrossSiteScripting_QUERYARGUMENTS, and CrossSiteScripting_COOKIE rules in COUNT mode overridden back to BLOCK via rule action override, plus a secondary custom rule with priority 1 that uses a regex pattern set matching common XSS vectors (script tags, event handlers, javascript: URIs) against query string parameters with BLOCK action and a 403 custom response body. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. CloudWatch metrics confirm both rules are actively evaluating and blocking requests. Note: the managed rule group version is pinned to Version_1.0 and auto-update is disabled; the custom regex rule uses a broad pattern `(?i)(<script|javascript:|on\w+\s*=)` which may not cover all encoding variants.

config.load_balancer: AWS ALB with WAFv2 WebACL association
